event: 43 Copa del Rey MAPFRE - ORC European Championship
procedural_matters: Panel composed as per RRS N1.4(b).
Tracking data provided by the International Jury.
facts: During the offshore race, mark Ma was the 3rd mark of the course with the boats reaching from mark To towards it and back from it again to mark To.
Sugar 3 and Guardamago were the direct competitors of POR 3440.
From the moment POR 3440 rounded mark Ma until Sugar 3 and Guardamago rounded it, the distance from the mark To to Ma changed by 17 meters.
The length of the offshore race was around 7h45m for the winner.
conclusions: The criteria of RRS 61.4 are not met.
